<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916949_theRebbe_558" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916949_theRebbe_558__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the work of refining the sparks during exile provides the strength to take all the vessels of silver, gold, and garments in the future redemption, which will be with an upraised hand, similar to the Exodus from Egypt, and that through our actions and service during the exile, especially in the period of the footsteps of Moshiach, the Jewish people will go out with an upraised hand to greet Moshiach our righteousness, speedily in our days.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this gives strength for the work of refining during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="1">and to take along all the matters,</t>
    <t s="2">vessels of silver and vessels of gold and garments,</t>
    <t s="3">in the future redemption which will be with an upraised hand</t>
    <t s="4">(just as was the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt,</t>
    <t s="5">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="6">"As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders")</t>
    <t s="7">that through our deeds and our service during the time of exile</t>
    <t s="8">and especially in the period of the footsteps of Moshiach, it will be that the children of Israel will go out with an upraised hand to greet Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="9">speedily in our actual days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
